Name: Teleporter Station
Description:
This mod adds two teleport buildings. The first is a long-range Wormhole Station that allows instant travel between all Stations of the same type. The other is a short range pair that allows access to remote regions.

[h1]Wormhole Station[/h1]
[list]
[*]The station links every wormhole of your district into one network, so a beaver can instantly travel to any other teleporter on the map, regardless of distance. It unlocks under the Paths build category for 20 Planks, 20 Metal Blocks and 50 Extract, at 5000 science.
[*]At least one station must be directly connected to district paths. The first one placed there assigns the network to that district. After that, the game refuses stations on any other district's paths. Every station placed after that joins the network on its own.
[*]Stations run on extract, and are filled by haulers. One extract is drawn every forty crossings, from the station the beaver walks into. The store holds up to 25, and the counter survives saving and loading.
[*]The panel's Transits row shows how many crossings the store will still cover. When the store hits zero, the station goes dark until extract arrives.
[*]Stations are automatically configured as either local (connected directly to district paths) or remote (only connected to the district through wormhole).
[*]Stations that run low can automatically pull extract through the wormhole siphon. A station pulls 1 extract at a time from the network's designated source. You designate a source from the panel of a local station, with the Enable/Disable wormhole siphon button. A source always keeps 4 in reserve, and only local stations can give.
[*]Any station can be paused from its panel. Levers, timers, and sensors can pause stations automatically, like any other building.
[*]The station is a hex-tread metal ring sitting on an eased wood ramp, with hand rails at the entrance. Materials follow the faction, with forged plank ramps for the Iron Teeth and walnut for the Folktails. The station fills one flat tile, and a path platform can be built directly over it.
[*]The event horizon takes its color from the network's district. A hash of the district center picks the hue, and it stays stable across saves. Spiral arms swirl through it by way of the game's own Spin node animation. A dry, disconnected, or paused station hides its horizon and stops the animation.
[/list]

[h1]Ring Station[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ring Stations work in pairs, and a pair's route is only between each other. Build one on your paths and deliver extract to it, then place the Remote Ring Station from its panel, free, anywhere within range. The remote needs no paths and no access, so it can sit on an island, a tower, or a cliff. The Ring Station costs 20 Planks, 20 Metal Blocks and 25 Extract, at 5000 science.
[*]A pair shares one extract store, held by the built ring. One extract covers forty crossings, and either panel shows the crossings left. When the store runs dry, the route closes until extract arrives.
[*]Pausing the built ring closes the route at both ends. Levers, timers, and sensors can pause the pair automatically, like any other building.
[*]The ring is a round metal plate set into a dirt path tile, and a pale inscription shows while the route can carry someone. A crossing is instant. Both plates of the pair pulse their transport rings at the same moment, in the district's color. Click either ring to show the line between the pair. The ring fills one flat tile, and a path platform can be built directly over it.
[/list]

[h1]Known issue[/h1]
[list]
[*]If a path platform stands directly over a ring, the crossing's ring pulse rises through the platform's deck.
[/list]

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
[list]
[*]Support for teleporters on more than one district.
[*]Balance is still being worked on. Extract needs grow extremely large as your colony grows, and future updates may let you burn science to reduce the extract each trip uses.
[/list]
